About the Scholarship

The Japanese Government MEXT Scholarship is fully funded for Master's and Doctoral programs via university recommendation.

OpportunityFully Funded Scholarship: MEXT Scholarship (University Recommendation) - Japan
HostGovernment of Japan
LocationVarious, Japan
Study LevelPhD, Master's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend144,000 yen/month (Master's) / 145,000 yen/month (Doctoral)
Application DeadlineRolling (Varies by University)
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Host Institution: Various Japanese Universities (NAIST, Osaka University, etc.)
  • Study Level: Master's, PhD
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded (MEXT)
  • Intake: October 2026
  • Stipend (Master's): 144,000 yen/month
  • Stipend (Doctoral): 145,000 yen/month
  • Duration (Master's): October 2026 – September 2028
  • Duration (Doctoral): October 2026 – September 2029
  • Coverage: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel, health insurance

Project Overview & Significance

The MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology) Scholarship is the most scholarship programme offered by the Japanese Government. The 'University Recommendation' pathway allows leading Japanese universities to directly recommend exceptional international candidates for the scholarship. This fully funded programme covers all expenses, ensuring that scholars can focus entirely on their academic and research pursuits. Japan is a global leader in technology, engineering, and scientific research. The MEXT scholarship aims to foster global leaders who will contribute to the academic and industrial collaboration between Japan and the rest of the world. The programme offers an unparalleled cultural and academic experience, allowing students to study in state-of-the-art laboratories while immersing themselves in Japan's rich, traditional culture.

Research Themes & Objectives

The scholarship is open to virtually all academic disciplines, though the participating universities often focus on STEM fields. Participating universities include NAIST, Yokohama National University, Osaka University, Nagoya Institute of Technology, and Tokyo Metropolitan University. Research themes vary widely depending on the chosen university and supervisor, ranging from advanced materials science and artificial intelligence to civil engineering and public policy. The core objective is to facilitate advanced, research while building a global network of Japan-sympathetic leaders and scholars.

Training & Development

MEXT scholars receive comprehensive support, including full tuition coverage, a generous monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, and health insurance. Many universities also offer supplementary Japanese language courses, helping international students integrate into the academic and social environment. Scholars have access to research facilities and are mentored by leading Japanese academics. The programme also includes cultural excursions and networking events, ensuring a well-rounded international experience.

Eligibility and Requirements

Applicants must be citizens of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan. They must hold a Bachelor's degree (for Master's application) or a Master's degree (for PhD application). Academic excellence is the primary criterion. The specific application process and deadlines vary depending on the recommending university, but typically require a strong academic record, letters of recommendation, and a detailed research plan.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Rolling (Varies by University) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About Government of Japan

The Government of Japan supports international education through Japanese Government scholarships administered by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology. Commonly called MEXT scholarships, these programmes provide study and research opportunities at Japanese institutions. Eligibility, funding and selection routes depend on the specific scholarship category and application cycle.

Official website: https://www.mext.go.jp/en/

How to Apply & Official Contacts

Prospective candidates must first apply directly to the participating Japanese university of their choice. The university's academic committee will review the application and, if successful, recommend the candidate to MEXT. Applicants should monitor the official websites of their target universities for specific application guidelines and deadlines.

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
